title: Limits of Hyperkähler Manifolds and Moduli Spaces of Sheaves on K3 Surfaces
summary: We prove that a compact strongly Gauduchon manifold which is a limit of compact hyperkähler manifolds is bimeromorphic to a compact hyperkähler manifold. This settles a case of a conjecture of Soldatenkov and Verbitsky. A closed completion of a Gauduchon metric bounds the Dirichlet energies of nearby biholomorphisms. This bound yields a meromorphic limit map, which has degree one and is therefore a bimeromorphism onto a compact hyperkähler manifold.
